demo.program:
# Tcl — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Tcl?", "John Ousterhout"),
    ("What paradigm is Tcl?", "procedural"),
    ("What is creator?", "John Ousterhout"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1988"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".tcl"),
    ("What is hello world?", "puts \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
